review_description: Very pleased with daily collection - waiting to see that it does in fact reflect positive results to our power account and a return for the exported generated energy to Energex!!!!This is the big IF???  Hopefully we are doing our bit to utilise this wonderful resource we have available in Qld!!!Being Pensioners - our big fear is the Govt. will change the rules, as they do, and our savings spent on this Solar Installation will be in vain.
